_comment: Claude Code DESKTOP app on Windows. Merge the 'hooks' key below into
C:\Users\<you>\.claude\settings.json (your Windows profile, NOT your WSL home),
then replace <you> with your WSL username and restart the app completely.
The paths are Linux paths inside WSL. Do not convert them to Windows paths.
MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 is REQUIRED. The desktop app runs hooks through Git Bash,
whose MSYS2 layer rewrites absolute POSIX arguments: without the prefix,
/home/<you>/... arrives at wsl.exe as C:/Program Files/Git/home/<you>/... and
fails with 'execvpe ... No such file or directory'.
Do NOT wrap these in 'cmd.exe /c'. Under Git Bash that spawns an interactive
cmd which eats the JSON payload from stdin and exits 0, so the hook reports
success while the device is never contacted.
The trailing 'win' argument tags the cell (Code W), suppresses ccusage stats
(they would report WSL CLI usage, not desktop usage), and makes the script run
synchronously, which a wsl.exe-bridged hook requires.
For the WSL/Linux/macOS CLI instead, use settings-snippet.json.
